observables.rationale: MAPPING: the readout is A_frac and the state is A, with no conversion — the note gives the FRET channel already normalised to the sensor total and the LC-MS channel in absolute uM against standards, so a scaling factor or an offset would be a fit device rather than a measurement model. NOISE: additive normal with one estimated sigma per observable. Additive because the note quotes a single absolute precision per channel from the replicate spread on standards, not a percentage; normal because the negative values at t = 0 have zero likelihood under a multiplicative or log-normal model.

MAPPING: the readout is P_uM and the state is P, with no conversion — the note gives the FRET channel already normalised to the sensor total and the LC-MS channel in absolute uM against standards, so a scaling factor or an offset would be a fit device rather than a measurement model. NOISE: additive normal with one estimated sigma per observable. Additive because the note quotes a single absolute precision per channel from the replicate spread on standards, not a percentage; normal because the negative values at t = 0 have zero likelihood under a multiplicative or log-normal model.

_fixture_note: No scaling and no offset on either channel, so every axis in this case is a MODEL axis. That is deliberate: an observation axis is not neutralizable by construction (it never touches the model), and this case exists to exercise the axes that are.
